title: gamma(Omega) from the QCA rule transfer operator

T1.statement: rule tick = oscillator phase rotation R(Omega) (orthogonal, det 1); transfer-operator vacuum <phi^2> = 1/(2 Omega) per mode (number-basis diagonalisation)

T2.statement: vacuum flux variance from the rule: sigma_phi^2 = <1/(2 Omega)>_BZ -> 0.40297 (Richardson, r=0.499); sigma_1 = sigma_phi^2/2 = (1/4)<1/Omega>_BZ = 0.20148

T3.statement: gamma(Omega) = clock^{-1}(exp(-sigma_phi^2/2)) = 1.78000 for the 2D rule (s_1 = 0.81752); clock round-trip exact; monotone in dispersion stiffness (1.302<1.780<2.252)

T4.statement: limits recover F99 D4 from the rule: stiff Omega -> gamma->inf, sigma->0 (deconfined); soft Omega -> gamma->0, sigma->inf (confining)

T5.statement: reconciliation: sigma_1=0.2015 same order & same BZ-inverse-dispersion origin as F70 floor sigma(20)=0.2192 and F95 I_2=0.2202 (consistency, not an identity: F70 sigma(60)=0.0687<sigma(20))
